description: Institutional load tier (§8.1): exercises high-volume mempool depth, queue drain, block commitment throughput, and infrastructure resource behaviour. Sustains 5,000 TPS for 30 minutes with a mixed payload (70% one-to-one, 30% multi-output).
walletProvisioningNote: external-key mode — set WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY to a pre-funded key whose UTxOs are initialized on the node before running replay scenarios
